answer: Relic milestone bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files one relic at each spiral milestone. Each milestone ripples a check to three random peers, who re-weigh the relic against its filed weight; a copied, reused, or misweighed relic burns the bond. A rented relic bears the lender's seal; both bonds burn. The k-th filing pays 47+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,044,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 47 once.
